P02 — Pedestal — Treleau

Pink marble pedestal from the Palace of Versailles, described by the author as 17th or 18th century.
Acquired official original OBJ archive through the normal Sketchfab download UI.
Changes: excluded separate ground scan; preserved original body geometry/UVs/normals except clipping a real custom sword slot; mirrored Z for Unity; uniformly normalized body to 1.20m high; resized original 8K body textures to 4K; packed original specular RGB and inverse roughness into alpha. Custom brass socket liner/cavity and collision setup are game additions. No endorsement implied.
